en.sayed-ali-raza: 130. When Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, returned from (the battle of) Ṣiffīn and noticed the graves outside Kūfah, he said:
O residents of houses which give a sense of loneliness, of depopulated areas and gloomy graves. O people of the dust, O victims of strangeness, O people of loneliness and O people of desolateness!
You have gone ahead and preceded us while we are following you and will meet you.
The houses (you left) have been inhabited by others; the wives (you left) have been married by others; the properties have been distributed (among heirs).
This is the news about those around us; what is the news about things around you?
